|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 4) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-captainphasma_ai-2025-12-12.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-D-captainphasma_ai-2025-12-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-D-captainphasma_ai-2022-12-12.png]], 12 December 2022) → [[File:V4-D-captainphasma_ai-2025-12-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-D-captainphasma_ai-2025-12-12.png]], 12 December 2025). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 3 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Phasma (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-captainphasmaaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/captainphasma_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/captainphasma_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Charming To The Last”; no “(AI)” label. Text: “Adds one battle destiny with a stormtrooper. If you just won a battle at same or related location, may retrieve a trooper.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Phasma (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021): re-made for the PC's January 2022 Alternate Image update: the copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd.” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the art credit, icons and text box were redrawn or moved; the label “(AI)” now prints. PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-Dark793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/captainphasma_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/captainphasma_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Charming To The Last”. Text: “Adds one battle destiny with a stormtrooper. If you just won a battle at same or related location, may retrieve a trooper.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Phasma (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/captainphasma_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-Dark12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/captainphasma_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/captainphasma_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the Players Committee logo (“SWCCG Players Committee”) now prints at bottom right, left of “(AI)”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. If you just won a battle at same or related location, may retrieve a trooper.”
